summary: This is a routine 6-K filed by Zhibao Technology Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting that it received a deficiency notice from Nasdaq for failing to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The filing is a standard regulatory disclosure required by Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A). The company has 180 calendar days, until January 6, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 closing bid price for 10 consecutive business days. No immediate delisting occurs, and no special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring is announced. A similar US filing would be an 8-K under Item 3.01 for non-compliance with exchange rules. The disclosure solely pertains to the deficiency notice and compliance timeline.
